args.body:
Hi Tailspin Ltd,

Following up on your report that hardware was shipped to the wrong site:

1. We have processed a refund of 45 for the reshipping fee.
2. We have corrected the shipping destination on your active order to the verified location (Pune DC).

Please allow a few business days for the refund to appear on your statement. If anything looks incorrect, just reply to this email and we'll take another look.

Thanks for your patience.
Support Team
